annotations.title: Read a web page as clean Markdown

description: Call this whenever you need the content of a web page: research, browsing, summarising, checking a source, following a link. Give it a URL and it returns the main content as clean Markdown (headings, lists, links and code kept; scripts, menus, footers and markup removed), plus the title, description, word count and the links on the page. Far fewer tokens than raw HTML, no model in the loop, typically under a second.
